simple.summary: בֵּית מַעֲכָה (Bêyth Maʻăkâh) means Beth-Maakah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Sam 20 14.

definitions.full: H1038. Beth Maakah מַעֲכָה בֵּית proper name, of a location so only וּב ׳אָבֵ֫לָה ׳מ 2Sam 20:14 , where read as in 20:15 and in בּ ׳אָבֵל ׳מ 1Kin 15:20 ; 2Kin 15:29 Abel of Beth Maacah ; with ָ ה locative; בּ ׳אָבֵ֫לָה הַמַּעֲכָה 2Sam 20:15 ; compare below II. אָבֵל .
